title: Singapore-based Companies that have Invested in Government's Overseas Industrial Park Projects
what_it_is: Singapore-based Companies that have Invested in Government's Overseas Industrial Park Projects

sections.label: Singapore companies in SIP
sections.summary: About 340 Singapore companies were in SIP by end-2016, with cumulative contractual investments of S$9.4 billion, and NUSRI incubating 37 startups.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: In the case of SIP, about 340 Singapore companies have established their presence there as at the end of 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Cumulative contractual investments by Singapore-based companies in SIP amounted to S$9.4 billion by the end of last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: NUSRI is currently incubating 37 Singapore and international technology startups.

sections.label: Singapore companies in TEC
sections.summary: As of June this year, 42 Singapore companies are registered in TEC with total registered capital over S$220 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: As of June this year, 42 Singapore companies are registered in TEC, with a total registered capital of more than S$220 million.

sections.label: Overseas success rate estimate
sections.summary: The speaker lacks exact data but says about two-thirds of companies succeed overseas, similar to SIP experience.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: I do not have the data on that offhand.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But I would imagine and, indeed, our experience in general has been there is no reason to think it is terribly different from what we have had in SIP and other places, which is about 70% or two-thirds.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: They go because there is a larger opportunity arising from whether it is a G-to-G project or some other element that is initiating it, such as one of their large clients going overseas and then they go with them.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, I would say it is not unusual to see about two-thirds, but I do not have an exact answer for the Member.

sections.label: Purposes of overseas company growth
sections.summary: Overseas growth helps companies expand beyond Singapore, invest in capabilities, and create opportunities for Singaporeans, tracked via agency grants.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: First, it is to help our companies grow beyond our domestic market; second, with that skill, it allows them to undertake a broader range of initiatives and invest more in their capabilities; and third, it allows us to also create good opportunities for Singaporeans, not just in terms of pursuing opportunities in these other markets, but also in developing capabilities here.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, there are ways to track it, and we look at it.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Certainly, when our agencies extend assistance to companies when they go overseas in terms of grants and so on, this becomes an important key performance indicator.
